principle: Inner pages inherit the established site design language without cloning the same page composition.
rules: Existing site design DNA outranks a new page's industry mood unless the user explicitly requests a rebrand.
Use the same token family across sibling pages but do not clone the same section sequence.
A new page may choose different compatible Sparks while preserving typography, color, radius, spacing, buttons, cards and media treatment.
Local section overrides remain local and must not silently become global site DNA.
Explicit user requests to rebrand or change global design tokens override inherited DNA after confirmation.
